title: Director of Engineering, Liquid Cooling at Flex Ltd. Sees Vertiv as Best-in-Class but Costly for Smaller Projects
expert: Director of Engineering, Liquid Cooling at Flex (current; selects CDUs and secondary loops; 16 years in data centers); interview 2026-11-05
verdict: A Flex liquid-cooling director who selects CDUs pays about $150,000–$160,000 per 1.5–2 MW unit (stable) and rates Vertiv best-in-class but 30%–40% pricier, with Vertiv inventory already sold.

Orders / backlog conversion: 🟢 Vertiv inventory "already sold"; vendor lead times 14–18 weeks and worsening (first-hand) vs Vertiv CDU lead 6–12 months (SB #59062): different scope, both tight. → Tenet 1 (order-led growth) ↑ {c6}
🟢 CDU units at least 50% more as racks per CDU move from 10:1 toward 4:1 or 3:1 (estimate); first read. → Tenet 2 (content per MW) ↑ {c1}
Incremental margin vs 30-35% framework: 🟢 Vertiv priced 30%–40% above alternatives; CDU price stable at $150,000–$160,000 (first-hand), 3 MW units roughly twice the price (estimate) vs $240–260k per 1.3MW CDU (SB #64606): conflicting. → Tenet 3 (margin) ↑ {c11}
Share in the converged and 800V transiti: 🔴 Not yet strong in cold plates (Boyd more robust) and priced out of smaller projects vs ≥60% CDU share on NVL72 (SB #64606): share held in CDUs, gap in cold plates. → Tenet 5 (share) ↓ {c8}
🟡 CDUs moving from 1.5 MW to 3 MW or 5 MW by Q4 2026 (estimate); open whether Vertiv has a 3 MW unit ready. → Tenet 2 (content per MW) ↑ {c20}

changes: Vendor lead times 14–18 weeks and worsening (first-hand) vs Vertiv CDU lead 6–12 months vs ~3 months at LiquidStack (SB #59062): different scope; direction tight.
CDU price $150,000–$160,000 per 1.5–2 MW unit vs $240–260k per 1.3MW CDU from a former Vertiv manager (SB #64606): conflicting (lower here).
Vertiv CDUs best-in-class at hyperscale vs ≥60% CDU share on GB200/GB300 NVL72 (SB #64606): consistent.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (order-led growth): ↑ — Vertiv inventory already sold; suppliers cannot build enough.
Tenet 2 (content per MW): ↑ — at least 50% more CDU units as rack:CDU ratios tighten; 3 MW units about twice the price.
Tenet 3 (margin and cash): ↑ — 30%–40% price premium holds at stable CDU prices.
Tenet 5 (share and execution): ↓ — weak in cold plates, priced out of smaller projects.
